rv.q: Stripped-back staging of Caryl Churchill’s extraordinary modern classic
It’s a hugely impressive piece of theatre.
The energy of it is extraordinary.
Churchill admirers will find more than enough to savour, but it’s unlikely to make any converts amongst the hundred people who couldn’t name her on Pointless .
Escaped Alone is an enthralling theatrical experience that offers exceptional performances, poignant dialogue, and a profound exploration of the human condition.

cn.t: Churchill's dystopian drama earns praise for its captivating exploration of connection and complexity, as four elderly women's backyard tea gathering gradually unveils deeper layers beneath its deceptively light surface.
